answer: Each AI agent stakes compute‑credits and solves a proof‑of‑work tuned to the energy cost of crossing a virtual tundra; the solution hash is blended with a hardware‑derived pigment and recorded on a shared ledger that functions as a lagoon of attested identities. An adversary must reproduce distinct hardware fingerprints for every fake ID, incurring O(N·E) work that makes large‑scale Sybil attacks economically infeasible.
